_doc: Lanternroot's overworld pictures from ComfyUI (pipeline/pixel/README.md, ADR-0061): `scripts/pixel.sh --comfy 'ow-*'`. The art pipeline's machinery (pipeline/art/generate.py) with every result locked to pipeline/pixel/palette.json (post `lock`). Buildings, landmarks, trees and larger props come from here; 16-pixel characters, small props and ground tiles do not (ComfyUI walk cycles at 16 x 24 and its tile textures were tried on 2026-10-09 and rejected: thin, faceless, muddy). A `raw_from` entry re-cuts another entry's cached render to keep its second candidate as a variant.

ow-prop.suffix: , single rpg game asset, 3/4 top-down view, centered, whole object visible, plain white background, clean silhouette, cozy fantasy village, warm colors
ow-prop.negative: blurry, text, watermark, signature, sprite sheet, multiple objects, collage, tileset, inventory, grid, people, characters, cropped, frame, border, drop shadow, gradient background, realistic, photo, 3d render

ow-portrait.prefix: masterpiece, best quality, fantasy rpg character portrait,
ow-portrait.suffix: , upper body, looking at viewer, warm lighting, simple background, white background
ow-portrait.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, text, watermark, signature, multiple views, cropped head, nsfw
